probe.text_sample: Your Page Title Go to homepage Navy Integrations Customers Pricing Changelog Blog Overview Sign in Buy Navy Go to homepage Navy /// Menu Integrations Customers Pricing Changelog Blog Overview Status Help center Sign in Buy Navy Changelog May 26, 2025 Status page subscribers and custom domains Customers can now subscribe to your status page and get every update by email. Status pages can also run on your own domain. Status pages can now keep your customers informed without anyone on your team sending a message. Visitors can subscribe by email and get every incident update and maintenance notice as it is posted. And your status page can now live on your own domain , on a status subdomain of the site your customers already know. Key Highlights: Email subscribers: Customers subscribe from the status page and get incident updates, maintenance reminders and resolution notices. Component subscriptions: Subscribers can choose only the components they care about. Custom domains: Point a CNAME to Navy and we issue and renew the SSL certificate for you. Private pages: Restrict a status page to your team or to signed-in customers. This release turns your status page into the first place custom
